data.name: Khadujah
data.gender_notes: Khadujah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Pure, innocent, and devoted to Allah
data.long_meaning: Khadujah is derived from the Arabic word 'khadaja', which means 'to seek'. This name is a beautiful reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge, truth, and Allah's pleasure. The name is also associated with the noble wife of Prophet Ibrahim, Hajar, who was known for her unwavering faith and devotion. The name Khadujah carries the meaning “Pure, innocent, and devoted to Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khadujah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, innocent, and devoted to allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the purity of heart and devotion to Allah.
